title: Gift Registry Entry Status Mix
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gift:registry
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(purchase_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the gift registry entry feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `purchase_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces the overall mood of your gift registry entry feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
